quote: Quality Estimation (QE) for Machine Translation (MT) aims to predict the quality of a machine-translated text without using reference translations.
Quality Estimation (QE) for Machine Translation (MT) aims to predict the quality of a machine-translated text without using reference translations.
We follow the evaluation method of the WMT QE tasks: Pearson's r correlation as the main metric, Mean-Absolute Error (MAE) and Root-Mean-Squared Error (RMSE) as secondary metrics.
